messages:
maria-partnerships: Heads-up — NeoEdge confirmed they can spin 8x A100 v5 GPUs in apac-southwest next week. Need quick approvals: marketplace SKU, quota bump, KMS connectivity, and a joint PR slot. Anyone able to triage?

kevin-cloud: Filing quota now. Do we have node sizing + expected qps?

tim-eng: Need rough perf numbers to pick kernel/sequence profiles. If it's low-latency edge traffic we should use the tiled-attn path.

maria-partnerships: Partner sent initial perf: ~600 qps aggregate, median p50 latency target 45ms. They prefer baremetal for latency but offer GKE later. Docs here: https://drive.redwood/neoedge/kms-certs (kms certs + network ACLs).

ashley-ops: If baremetal, autoscaler hooks are different — need a manual burst policy and health probes. Can you confirm we can do 2 nodes baseline, burst to 4?

kevin-cloud: I'll create a capacity request. Planned: 2 nodes (4 GPUs each) baseline, burst policy up to 4. Creating CR now.

deploy-bot: Capacity request created: CR-2026-742 (assigned to @kevin-cloud). Status: pending quota approval.

kevin-cloud: Quota request submitted to partner portal (portal id 87432). Also asked partner to run an HSM/KMS connectivity test — they support external HSM. ETA 48h.

ryan-legal: Quick legal note — need to review SI integration doc for data residency and log access clauses before we finalize marketplace listing. Send me the latest SI docs.

maria-partnerships: Sent SI doc: https://drive.redwood/neoedge/si-integration-v1.pdf — highlights: no customer data exfiltration, logs retained 30d, partner ops access via jumpbox with RBAC.

tim-eng: I'll prepare a runtime profile "neoedge-apac-swx" and a canary config. Plan: canary on 1 node, traffic ramp 5% -> 25% -> 100% with health gates (latency, error rate, kv-cache hit).

ashley-ops: I'll add autoscale policy and alert thresholds. Proposed alerts: p95 latency >120ms, error rate >1% for 5min.

suzanne-marketing: Marketing would like a joint blog + partner quote. Can we target Apr 8 for announcement? Need PR draft and partner logos by Apr 1.

kevin-cloud: Portal approved the marketplace entitlement; updating CR: CR-2026-742 -> approved at 1719998960. KMS test window scheduled Tue 10:00 UTC (partner confirmed).

tim-eng: PR opened: #4782 — adds runtime profile + kernel selector tweaks. I'll attach the canary runbook and dashboards to the PR.

maria-partnerships: Next-steps checklist:
- [ ] Legal signoff (ryan-legal)
- [ ] Marketplace & quota confirmed (kevin-cloud)
- [ ] Runtime PR + canary (tim-eng)
- [ ] Ops autoscale + monitoring (ashley-ops)
- [ ] Marketing assets & PR draft (suzanne-marketing)
I'll book a 15m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to hand off.

suzanne-marketing: :thumbsup: I'll start a one-pager and request partner logo files.

ryan-legal: Reviewing SI doc now, will ping with any redlines by EOD.

maria-partnerships: Awesome — moving to greenlight pending legal. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
